_readme: Facts used to answer Naukri screening questions. 'pattern' is a regex matched against the lower-cased question. 'answer' may be a string or a list of acceptable option texts (first match wins). Anything containing REPLACE_ME is ignored, and the job is skipped (and logged in unanswered_questions.json) until you fill it in. Only put TRUE facts here.

rules.pattern: total (work |overall |professional |relevant )?experience|overall experience|how many years of (work )?experience do you have$
notice period|when can you join|how soon can you join|joining (time|period)|available to join
